current_evidence: The council's 'Information requirements for planning applications' page (last updated 14 April 2026) links the 'Local Validation Checklist (published 1 April 2025)' PDF on SharePoint, and the council news item says that from 1 April 2025 all applications must use the updated, consolidated Somerset-wide checklist.

issues.detail: Grokbot's URL is the council's information-requirements landing page, not the validation list itself. Grokbot read only this page and never opened the linked Local Validation Checklist PDF. As a result it captured just 2 tab items and 4 app-type rows ('Extraction level: Partial') from what is a full checklist broken down by application type.
issues.evidence: Page section 'Somerset Local Validation Checklist' links 'Local Validation Checklist (published 1 April 2025)' at somersetcc.sharepoint.com; Grokbot docs_read lists only the landing page.

issues.detail: Grokbot leaves List date and Date basis empty and marks the list 'Undated'. The page gives a date: the checklist was published 1 April 2025 and applies to all applications from that date.
issues.evidence: Page: 'Local Validation Checklist (published 1 April 2025)'; news item: 'From 1 April 2025 all applications must use the updated, consolidated checklist'.

issues.detail: Householder is shown as '(none)', but the checklist has local householder requirements. These are: a street scene where the access changes; section plans where ground levels change; levels for all detached buildings and for extensions whose floor levels differ from the main dwelling; an ecology report or bat survey (roof, loft or outbuilding works in Bat Consultation Zones, rural areas, or near woodland or watercourses); a Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zone 2/3 or within 8m of a main river, with a Householder FRA form provided); a heritage statement (conservation area, listed building or scheduled monument); a Design and Access Statement (listed building, or conservation area where floorspace is 100m2 or more); and a BS5837 tree survey where trees on or next to the site could be affected.
issues.evidence: Nov 2024 Somerset-wide consultation draft, Householder table; live page links 'Householder Flood Risk Assessment information and form'.

issues.detail: Nutrient neutrality requirements are missing. Grokbot captured only a pointer sentence to the Phosphates page. The checklist requires a Nutrient Neutrality Assessment and Mitigation Strategy (NNAMS), Habitat Regulations Assessment information and a Phosphate Budget Calculator in the Somerset Levels and Moors Ramsar and River Axe SAC catchments. Triggers include new residential units (including tourist accommodation and traveller sites), agricultural development that increases herd size, and commercial uses with overnight accommodation. Application types covered are full, outline, reserved matters, s73 (where floorspace or drainage changes), pre-commencement discharges, retrospective applications, and prior approvals in the River Axe catchment.
issues.evidence: Draft checklist general items, 'Nutrient Neutrality Assessment and Mitigation Strategy (NNAMS)'; page section 'Phosphates within Somerset'.

issues.detail: Area-specific requirements are missing. These are: the Climate Emergency Checklist (West area only, on full, outline, LBC, s73 and LDC); the Local Labour Agreement / Employment and Skills Plan (North and West areas, major developments of more than 50 dwellings or 5,000sqm commercial); the Health Impact Assessment (North and former West Somerset, generally 100+ dwellings or 5ha+); and the Sustainability Checklist and Energy Statement (all development, including extensions and conversions, in the former Taunton Deane area).
issues.evidence: Draft checklist 'Other Supporting Information': 'Climate Emergency Checklist: West area only'; 'Local Labour Agreement: North and West areas only ... Major development > 50 dwellings'.

issues.detail: Requirements for major and full applications are missing. These are: a Fire Statement (two or more dwellings and 18m+ or 7+ storeys); a Site Waste Management Statement or Plan; a Surface Water Drainage Assessment; a Transport Assessment and Travel Plan; the Active Travel England toolkit (150+ dwellings, 7,500m2+ non-residential floorspace, or 5ha+ sites); a Contaminated Land Report; a noise, vibration and odour evaluation; an LVIA (solar or wind, open countryside, National Landscape); a Retail Impact Assessment (over 2,500m2 of retail, leisure or office floorspace); an archaeological assessment (areas of high archaeological potential); a Planning Statement; a Design and Access Statement; a Landscape Plan; and a tree survey.
issues.evidence: Draft checklist tables 'Full Planning Application, Minor Development' and 'Major Development'.

issues.detail: Threshold-based supporting documents are missing. These are: an Affordable Housing Statement and draft S106 Heads of Terms (6+ units in a rural location or 10+ urban); a Local Housing Needs Assessment (6+ units); a Public Open Space, Play and Recreation Statement (8+ units); an Agricultural Appraisal (agricultural buildings or rural workers' dwellings in the countryside); a Business Case (holiday lets in the countryside); an Education Impact Assessment; a Structural Survey and Conversion Method Statement (listed building structural works or rural building conversions); a Viability or Marketing Assessment; and a Statement of Community Involvement.
issues.evidence: Draft checklist 'Other Supporting Information': 'Affordable Housing Statement: Residential development of 6 or more units within a rural location or 10 or more in an urban location'.

issues.detail: Several application types are marked '(none)' but have local items. Reserved matters: a Compliance Statement (majors, and minors discharging conditions), BNG Overall and Phase Gain Plans for phased schemes, and a red line that does not extend beyond the outline. Advertisement consent: advertisement drawings showing colours, materials, dimensions and illumination, plus elevations. Listed building consent: elevations and floor plans (local requirement) and the Climate Emergency Checklist (West). Lawful development certificates: a planning statement with evidence (4- or 10-year rule). S73: an S73 BNG Statement and a planning statement explaining the change. Works to trees: a tree report for TPO trees where they are said to be diseased or dangerous or to be causing property damage. Change of use: a planning statement for all applications.
issues.evidence: Draft checklist tables for Reserved Matters, Advertisement Consent, Listed Building Consent, Certificates of Lawfulness, s73, Tree Works and Change of Use.

issues.detail: Bat SAC requirements are missing. The page names three bat Special Areas of Conservation (North Somerset and Mendip; Exmoor and Quantocks; Hestercombe House) and points to consultation zone guidance. Bat surveys are triggered in Bat Consultation Zones.
issues.evidence: Page section 'Special Areas of Conservation for bats - Technical Guidance'.

issues.detail: Minerals and waste local requirements were not captured. The page says separate local information requirements apply and links a separate minerals and waste 'Local Validation Checklist guidance' document, which Grokbot did not read.
issues.evidence: Page section 'Mineral and Waste Applications' linking 'Local Validation Checklist guidance' (SharePoint PDF).

issues.detail: The Biodiversity Net Gain row sits under 'Minerals & waste (county)' with the note 'Application type named in requirement text'. Its trigger excerpt is page navigation text ('information requirements Biodiversity Net Gain Phosphates within Somerset Mineral and Waste Applications Plan Examples Downloads ...'). In the source, the BNG validation addendum and declaration form apply to BNG-liable full, outline and reserved matters applications.
issues.evidence: Page: 'The council has adopted BNG validation requirements that go beyond the national minimum ... A BNG declaration form is required'; draft: 'BNG package applies to BNG-liable full, outline, and reserved matters applications'.

issues.detail: Flood Risk Assessment, Biodiversity Checklist and Ecological Survey are placed only under Full planning ('INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'). The source also applies them to householder, change of use, outline, reserved matters and s73 applications, and provides a dedicated householder FRA form.
issues.evidence: Page: 'Householder Flood Risk Assessment information and form'; draft Householder, Change of Use, Outline and s73 tables list ecology report and FRA.

issues.detail: The Biodiversity Checklist trigger excerpt starts mid-link ('- GOV.UK Biodiversity Checklist The Biodiversity Checklist has been produced to assist developers...'). It describes the form but does not say when it must be submitted.
issues.evidence: Page: Biodiversity Checklist is 'used to assess whether a wildlife or ecology survey is needed'; draft lists it in the BNG package for BNG-liable applications.

issues.detail: Both tab items are link labels or pointers, not requirements with triggers: 'Biodiversity Net Gain Declaration Form (PDF) Biodiversity Net Gain Declaration Form (DOC) Please see the Biodiversity Net Gain page...' and 'Phosphates within Somerset Please see the Phosphates page...'.
issues.evidence: Grokbot tab_items text matches link text on the landing page.

summary: Grokbot's link is the landing page rather than the 1 April 2025 Somerset-wide Local Validation Checklist it links to. Grokbot never read that PDF, so almost every local requirement is missing and the list is wrongly recorded as undated. The final PDF on SharePoint is robots-blocked to fetch, so the detailed comparison used the live page plus the Nov 2024 consultation draft of the same checklist; the final may differ in detail.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
